name: Olympic National Park
policyReason: The park says pets are not allowed on most trails, only on a short list.
summary: Pets are allowed on a few listed trails and some beaches, not most trails or wilderness beaches.

excerpts.quote: Pets are not allowed on most park trails or any wilderness beaches.

dogRules.text: Kalaloch beaches and Ruby Beach allow leashed pets.
Rialto Beach only from the parking lot to Ellen Creek.
Not on Second Beach, Third Beach or Ozette.
Olympic National Forest trails allow leashed pets.
